closest_prior_paper: Elazar et al. 2021 Amnesic Probing; also Belinkov 2022 survey

prior_controls: control tasks / random features in the probing literature
already_establishes_our_observation: ALREADY ESTABLISHED that probes are not causally sufficient in general
precise_method_difference: We add a direction in ker(W) while requiring the full 64x3 frozen-probe probability vector to stay within atol; we do not erase the board from the residual
precise_evidence_difference: Othello-GPT legal-move Y under complete probe-proba invariance, not BERT POS erasure
scientifically_substantial: Yes as a controlled Othello operationalization; no as a general thesis about probes
changes_what_a_researcher_can_conclude: A reader can conclude that this frozen Othello board probe's kernel still affects legal-move outputs; they cannot conclude that probing is newly shown to be insufficient
